concerns.text: T012's calibrator requires `data/raw/golden_dataset.csv` 'produced by the physical sweep in T005', but no task creates a file with that name — T005 only writes per-run CSVs to `data/raw/`. The artifact T012 depends on has no producing task; add golden-dataset assembly to T005/T006 or rename T012's input.

FR-003 requires the sweep to vary 'artificially injected network latency/packet loss', but T005's sweep_config defines only 'injected latency levels'; packet-loss injection is never swept or even mentioned in any task. Add packet-loss levels to the sweep grid or cite where they're covered.
Plan scope includes 'stress tests' alongside replicates and configs, but no task delivers any stress testing. Either add a task or the plan element is uncovered.

The constitution requires a pinned `requirements.txt` under `code/` and pinned random seeds; no task creates `code/requirements.txt` or documents seed pinning. T001 sets up the project layout but omits both.

Data-model §4 and Constitution III require checksums of every `data/` file recorded in the project state YAML and a PII scan before commit; no task performs checksumming or the PII scan. Add to T004/T005/T015 or a dedicated task.

Plan's structure diagram specifies `orchestrator/instrumentor.py` as a separate module, but T002 folds all instrumentation into `node_manager.py`; the plan element has no matching task file. Update the plan diagram or restore the module (cosmetic mismatch, but a plan element without a covering task).
